article.title: When should a small business adopt AI? A 2026 guide

beats.vo: Is your small business late to AI? Probably not. But waiting another year will cost you.
Start with one boring process you repeat every single week. Invoices, follow-up emails, booking confirmations. Boring is good: boring is predictable.
Before you buy anything, write down how many hours that process eats every week. That number is your baseline, and it is the only honest way to know if the tool paid for itself.

beats.label: of small firms saved *time* in 3 months
beats.vo: Seventy-three percent of small firms that did exactly this saw real time savings within three months.
Good first tasks are repetitive, rule based, and easy to measure. If you can't measure it, you can't prove it worked.
And fix the process before you automate it. AI makes a messy process faster, not better.
The full step-by-step guide is on biglobster dot top. Link in the description.
